charms.name: Wound
charms.description: Triggers on a creature with a certain chance and deals 5% of its initial hit points as physical damage once.

charms.name: Enflame
charms.description: Triggers on a creature with a certain chance and deals 5% of its initial hit points as fire damage once.

charms.name: Poison
charms.description: Triggers on a creature with a certain chance and deals 5% of its initial hit points as earth damage once.

charms.name: Freeze
charms.description: Triggers on a creature with a certain chance and deals 5% of its initial hit points as ice damage once.

charms.name: Zap
charms.description: Triggers on a creature with a certain chance and deals 5% of its initial hit points as energy damage once.

charms.name: Curse
charms.description: Triggers on a creature with a certain chance and deals 5% of its initial hit points as death damage once.

charms.name: Cripple
charms.description: Cripples the creature with a certain chance and paralyzes it for 10 seconds.

charms.name: Parry
charms.description: Any damage taken is reflected to the aggressor with a certain chance.

charms.name: Dodge
charms.description: Dodges an attack with a certain chance without taking any damage at all.

charms.name: Adrenaline Burst
charms.description: Bursts of adrenaline enhance your reflexes with a certain chance after you get hit and let you move faster for 10 seconds.

charms.name: Numb
charms.description: Numbs the creature with a certain chance after its attack and paralyzes the creature for 10 seconds.

charms.name: Cleanse
charms.description: Cleanses you from within with a certain chance after you get hit and removes one random active negative status effect and temporarily makes you immune against it.

charms.name: Bless
charms.description: Blesses you and reduces skill and xp loss by 10% when killed by the chosen creature.

charms.name: Scavenge
charms.description: Enhances your chances to successfully skin/dust a skinnable/dustable creature.

charms.name: Gut
charms.description: Gutting the creature yields 20% more creature products.

charms.name: Low Blow
charms.description: Adds 8% critical hit chance to attacks with critical hit weapons.

charms.name: Divine Wrath
charms.description: Triggers on a creature with a certain chance and deals 5% of its initial hit points as holy damage once.

charms.name: Vampiric Embrace
charms.description: Adds 4% Life Leech to attacks if wearing equipment that provides life leech.

charms.name: Void's Call
charms.description: Adds 2% Mana Leech to attacks if wearing equipment that provides mana leech.

charms.name: Savage Blow
charms.description: Adds critical extra damage to attacks with critical hit weapons.

charms.name: Fatal Hold
charms.description: Prevents creatures from fleeing due to low health for 30 seconds.

charms.name: Void Inversion
charms.description: Chance to gain mana instead of losing it when taking Mana Drain damage.

charms.name: Carnage
charms.description: Killing a monster deals physical damage to others in a small radius.

charms.name: Overpower
charms.description: Deals physical damage based on your maximum health.

charms.name: Overflux
charms.description: Deals physical damage based on your maximum mana.
